title: console-tooling-standup-2026-03-24
body:
Date: 2026-03-24
Type: Weekly console & tooling engineering standup (UI, rollouts, analytics)
Owner / facilitator: Priya Natarajan
Attendees: Priya, Alex, Miguel, Zoe, Evan (+ async updates from Sam, Anika)
Duration: 30m

Quick context / goals for the week:
- Stabilize the rollout framework for per-customer feature gates (canary + auto-fallback).
- Finish UI polish for rollout dashboard (latency histograms, error rates).
- Shipping initial analytics hooks for token-level cost breakdown (backend + UI surface).

Notes / updates by area:
1) Rollouts (Miguel)
- What went well: Canary pipeline fixed a sequencing bug discovered last Thursday; now canaries start in the shaded pool before region ramp.
- Current focus: implement automatic fallback to the previous model variant when error rate > 5% for the last 5 minutes (PROJ-4823). Working on the evaluation window config UI in the console.
- Blockers: need a decision from infra on whether fallback traffic should be routed to Dedicated tier or Hosted compatible variant (waiting on infra ticket INF-211).
- Pending PRs: rollouts-service: PR #238 (health-check smoothing) — needs one more SRE review.

2) UI / Console (Zoe + Alex)
- Dashboard: added latency histograms and per-route token cost column. UX review scheduled Friday.
- Chat messages: streaming UX is flakier in Safari — Alex to file a smaller follow-up for polyfill handling; repro steps added to the GitHub issue.
- Accessibility pass: basic keyboard nav for the rollout details modal done.
- TODOs: wire up the "compare variant" modal with the new analytics endpoint (blocked until analytics emits the variant metrics).
- Design note: decided to keep latency buckets at 10ms granularity for 0-200ms, 50ms for 200-500ms to keep charts readable (see Confluence notes).

3) Analytics / Instrumentation (Evan)
- Backend: implemented token-level cost tags in the trace proto; initial perf looks good ( <5% overhead).
- Metrics: emitting per-variant error_rate, p50/p95 latency, tokens_generated; these are available in the staging metrics cluster.
- Data pipeline: working with infra to add a short TTL index on the rollup table to avoid large hot partitions.
- Blockers: need the console team to provide the exact schema they expect for the variant comparison call (schema in linked PR). Zoe to drop schema by EOD.

4) Integrations / infra notes (Priya)
- Dedicated routing: infra suggested a config flag at the routing layer to prefer Dedicated when available — decision needed. Pros/cons discussed in meeting: Dedicated is predictable but may increase cost for canaries.
- Secrets / keys: Key rotation for analytics ingest is scheduled for Mar 29; will affect staging ingestion for 2 hours.

Risks / blockers summary:
- Decision on fallback routing (Dedicated vs Hosted) blocking rollout auto-fallback implementation (owner: infra + product).
- Analytics schema handshake missing (owner: console UI).
- One SRE review pending for rollouts PR; delaying canary smoothing in prod if not merged by Mon.

Decisions made in this standup:
- Accept smaller UX polyfill fix as a patch release (Alex) to address Safari streaming issues; full refactor deferred.
- Keep latency bucket granularity as proposed for the dashboard (Zoe).

Action items / owners:
- Miguel: follow up with infra on fallback routing decision (target: 2026-03-26).
- Zoe: drop analytics variant comparison schema into PR by EOD 2026-03-24.
- Alex: open patch PR for Safari streaming polyfill and add test matrix entry (due 2026-03-26).
- Evan: coordinate with infra on TTL index change and schedule short maintenance window (due 2026-03-25).
- Priya: escalate SRE review for rollouts PR #238 if not reviewed by Mon morning.

Async notes / FYIs:
- Sam: added a short eval prompt set to exercise long context rollouts; results in Confluence.
- Anika: customer success flagged two customers that want earlier access to variant compare — Priya to triage with sales.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Who signs off on per-customer Dedicated usage for canaries (product + finance)? Need an approval flow.
- Should we include cost delta estimates in the rollout modal (yes if we can emit a 24h estimate; put on backlog).

Next meeting:
- Weekly standup: 2026-03-31 same time. Recommend a short Q&A with SRE next week to unblock PR review.

Notes to self (informal):
- Quick TODO: push a light doc to Confluence that outlines the fallback routing options + cost implications (deadline: end of week) — will help the infra/product decision.
- Keep the rollout smoke test script handy for release day (script location: github/ops/rollout-smoke).

Attachments / links:
- Confluence: Console Rollouts Plan (linked above).
- GitHub PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollouts/pull/238, https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1294
- Jira: PROJ-4823 (auto-fallback), PROJ-4871 (dashboard variant compare)

End of notes.
